author: IGN
description:
Welcome to IGN's Review Crew, where IGN's reviewers and other reviewers break down their verdicts on the biggest releases in gaming. Today, the panel dives deep into the Crew's Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Review, the highly anticipated final installment of Infinity Ward's rebooted CoD quadrilogy.

Join host Daemon Hatfield, IGN's Simon Cardy (Modern Warfare 4 Campaign & Multiplayer reviewer) and Jarrett Greene (MW4 DMZ reviewer), alongside special guest Riana Manuel-Pena from GamerTag Radio, as they unpack the entirety of the MW4. With the game currently sitting at an impressive 86 on OpenCritic, the consensus is overwhelmingly positive. But is Modern Warfare 4 worth playing? Or there any part of the new Call of Duty that misses the mark?

#IGN #Gaming #CallOfDuty
title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 Review Crew: A Great Campaign, But There's a Catch

author: IGN
description:
Watch the trailer for Pendulum, an upcoming thriller mystery movie starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Phoebe Dynevor, Anna Deavere Smith, Jena Malone, with Norman Reedus, and Jacki Weaver. 

After a shared tragedy, Patrick (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) and Abigail (Phoebe Dynevor) seek healing at a secluded new-age retreat in New Mexico. But as Abigail falls deeper under the spell of the group’s charismatic leader (Jacki Weaver), Patrick's fear for his wife spirals into something far more sinister. Is he losing her to a cult, or losing his grip on reality? Trapped between his own unraveling mind and a truth he can't yet see, Patrick must untangle the truth before it costs him everything.

Pendulum is produced by  Darren Aronofsky, Jacob Jaffke p.g.a., Élan Klein Jaffke p.g.a., Will Greenfield p.g.a., Mark Heyman, and Dave Caplan. It is written by Mark Heyman.

Pendulum, directed by Mark Heyman, opens in theaters nationwide on January 1, 2027.

#IGN #Movies
title: Pendulum - Official Trailer #2 (2026) Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Phoebe Dynevor, Norman Reedus

author: IGN
description:
GTA is a lightning rod for urban legends, myths and easter eggs. From cut content such as Darkel in GTA 3, to the strange Dodo airplane, along with Bigfoot and his supposed appearance in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, to the Mount Chiliad mystery in GTA 5 and more, this is our breakdown of GTA's strangest myths, offering up a full history throughout the series' many entries. What myths and easter eggs do you expect to see in GTA 6, and throughout Grand Theft Auto, what are your favorite myths?

#IGN #GrandTheftAuto #GTA
title: GTA’s Strangest Myths: A Full History

description:
Check out the trailer for the upcoming anime, Maiden Blood! A Brand-New Dark Fantasy from Seiji Kishi, Makoto Uezu, LAM, and Polygon Pictures － "Maiden Blood” Set to Premiere in 2027! Armageddon—the final war between good and evil, fought at the end of the world. Its
destined outcome was overturned. “I don’t want to die.” That desperate wish, that hopeless
human ego, gave power to the Evil God. Eight billion human beings were offered as
sacrifices, and only a handful were allowed to survive, doomed to be toyed with and
tormented as playthings of the Evil God. Since the dawn of the universe, the
Frashokereti—the Renewal of the World—has been repeated countless times. But here, for
the first time, it has failed.

author: IGN
description:
One thing Phantom Blade 0 makes very clear is that pretty much everything wants to kill you. Sure, you’ve got a sword in your hand, and some slick moves to help you fight back, but outside of that, it doesn’t tell you a whole lot about keeping your imminent murder from happening. Fortunately, you’ve got a deeper bag of tricks than you might realize. Here are nine things Phantom Blade Zero doesn’t tell you. 
 
Timecodes:
0:00 - Intro
0:32 - Switching Weapons Mid-Battle Is Vital
1:34 - You're Invincible During Finishers
2:08 - It's Kind of a Metroidvania!
2:52 - Quests Can Disappear
3:28 - Respecs Are Free (To A Point)
4:11 - Weapon Abilities Are Game-Changing
5:37 - Upgrades May Come Later Than Resources
6:11 - Lore Isn't Just For Worldbuilding
6:45 - It's Not A Soulslike
7:27 - Outro
title: Phantom Blade Zero - 9 Things It Doesn't Tell You
